property.name: Moustache Goa Luxuria
property.description: Set within tropical gardens, this relaxed resort is 2 km from both Chapora Beach and the 16th-century Chapora Fort, and 8 km from bustling Mapusa Friday Market. Featuring free Wi-Fi and bright decor, the unfussy rooms include TVs, minifridges, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Upgraded rooms add minibars, flat-screen TVs and patios, and some have private gardens. Suites provide living areas, while upgraded suites add 4-poster beds. There's a rooftop bar/restaurant that serves international cuisine and cocktails, as well as an outdoor pool with a kids' area and a hot tub. Breakfast is available for a surcharge.
property.address: Plot No 399/7N Zorin Village, Chapora, near St Anthony Hospital, Vagator, Anjuna, Goa 403509
